#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

typedef long long int ll;

const ll MOD = 1000000007LL;

ll mul_pow(ll base, ll exp) {
    ll result = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < exp; ++i) {
        result = (result * base) % MOD;
    }
    return result;
}

ll compute(ll p, ll k) {
    if (k <= 1) {
        return mul_pow(p, p - 1 + k);
    }
    int order = 1;
    ll cur = k;
    while (cur != 1) {
        cur = (cur * k) % p;
        ++order;
    }
    return mul_pow(p, (p - 1) / order);
}

int main() {
    ll p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    cout << compute(p, k) << endl;
    return 0;
}
